description: Notional and margin required for a forex position, in the pair's own quote currency: no live FX rate needed. Never built for Phase 1 of this domain since a margin figure has no natural currency-neutral form the way pip value does. Prefer workflow.run_forex_margin_required_live instead when the account currency differs from the pair's quote currency. Use when user asks "how much margin do I need for X lots of EUR/USD at 50:1?". Returns: notionalQuote, marginQuote, base, quote.

pair.description: Currency pair in BASE/QUOTE format, e.g. "EUR/USD"

name: workflow.run_forex_margin_required
